gloss: to be absorbed in reading; to read avidly

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {読|よ}みふけりませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {読|よ}みふけっていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {読|よ}みふけっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be absorbed in reading; to be engrossed in a book
definitions.explanation: To become so focused on reading that one loses track of time or forgets about one's surroundings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}みふけった。
examples.english: I was absorbed in a novel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}みふけって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was engrossed in manga at the library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧おそく⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{推理|すいり}{小説|しょうせつ}→推理小説：28077_suirishousetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}みふけって、⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つけば⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧になっていた。
examples.english: I got so engrossed in a mystery novel late at night that before I knew it, it was morning.

notes:
{読|よ}みふける is an intransitive godan verb ({読|よ}みふけった, {読|よ}みふけって, {読|よ}みふけらない). Compound of ⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧ (reading) + ⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧ (to be absorbed in). The auxiliary ⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧ attaches to other verb stems as well (e.g., ⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧, {物思|ものおも}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧).

ASPECT (ている):
{読|よ}みふけって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the ongoing state of being absorbed in reading.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}みふける (to be engrossed in a book)
- ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}みふける (to be absorbed in a novel)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}みふける (to be lost in a novel)
- {本|ほん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{読|よ}みふける (to be absorbed in a book)
- ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧{読|よ}みふける (to read all day long)
